force_rate.tooltip: 24 resamples to H3's expected FPS without changing nominal duration or audio. 0 keeps source frames (not normally for H3).

H3ContinuumVideoAdapter.name: H3ContinuumVideoAdapter
H3ContinuumVideoAdapter.description: Converts Core Load Video's VIDEO to IMAGE frames and AUDIO. Use Force Rate 24 for H3 Video Guide. No file selector or Enable. Disable the whole video-input group, or bypass this adapter, to disconnect its optional Sampler inputs.
